findings.issue: Common nouns (construct שַׁבָּת + absolute שַׁבָּתוֹן) are dumped as untranslated Hebrew lemmas instead of Spanish.
Common noun שַׁבָּת is dumped as the untranslated lemma shabat.

notes: Year, seventh, será, a la tierra, Jehová, tu campo, no sembrarás, y tu viña, and no podarás match the tokens.
